purpose: Overall system design of doc-link: system boundary, operations and their connections, build sequence, and common invariants.
summary: System boundary: doc-link handles document IDs, ToC, search, DLID resolution, reference checks and impact notifications
Write boundary: only DLIDs in frontmatter and heading ends may be written; links and body text are never modified
Table of operations with inputs, outputs and write boundaries
ToC build order: target fixing, ID check, change detection, information gathering, reference check, candidate check, commit
Documents without IDs or with duplicate IDs are excluded and reported without stopping the build
Overall sequence diagram of index-docs and the separate check-impact operation
Common invariants such as ID independence, no partial candidate exposure, and no stored notification state
Notes on decisions deferred to individual design documents

Implementing ToC build or index-docs flow
